title: Self-Hosted Agents: what it uses
lede: One arrow for each component this feature lists. The steps reuse the feature's own "how it works" text; nothing here is a new claim. Internal and confidential: this text comes from an internal Ping deck and has not been tested on our tenant.

steps.title: Self-hosted agent identity
steps.what: A self-hosted agent is a Privilege platform component acting as its own non-human principal.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.

steps.title: Short-lived audience-scoped token
steps.what: It holds an identity the platform issued for it, and it authenticates every operation with a short-lived token minted for a Privilege-generated audience.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.

steps.title: Privilege-generated audience
steps.what: It holds an identity the platform issued for it, and it authenticates every operation with a short-lived token minted for a Privilege-generated audience.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.

steps.title: Controller verification of issuer, subject, a…
steps.what: The controller verifies issuer, subject, audience and scope on every report.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.

steps.title: Federated Identity policy binding
steps.what: A policy bound to a Federated Identity decides what the agent may do.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.

steps.title: Modes
steps.what: It can be scoped to named namespaces or to the whole cluster, with modes of off, audit and enforce and actions of allow, monitor, warn and deny.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.

steps.title: Actions
steps.what: It can be scoped to named namespaces or to the whole cluster, with modes of off, audit and enforce and actions of allow, monitor, warn and deny.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.

steps.title: Kubernetes eBPF sensor
steps.what: The first self-hosted agent is the Kubernetes sensor, the eBPF sensor that discovers AI agents, MCP servers and self-hosted model servers inside pods.
steps.why: Platform components are implicitly trusted infrastructure.
